messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — GPU quota errors detected in gcp-europe-west1. Autoscaler failing to create nodes (API errors: QUOTA_EXCEEDED). Backlog growing on dedicated pools. Paging oncall SRE.

pagerduty-bot: Paging sara (oncall-sre) — escalation level: pager.

sara (oncall-sre): on it. pulling up dashboard. queue length looks bad for `dedicated-pool-eu1` — 14k pending requests, 99th latency spiking to 9.2s.

raj (infra): confirming GCP responses show "insufficient quota for requested resource 'NVIDIA_TESLA_A100'" on region europe-west1. Attempts to create 8x GPU instances blocked.

maria (eng-runtime): autoscaler retries are hitting the same error: `QuotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUS_ALL_REGIONS' or region-level GPU quota`. Logs: ```2026-03-14T08:00:12Z autoscaler: createInstance(instanceConfig) -> 403 QuotaExceeded```

kevin (support): any customer-visible errors? Support pages show increased 429s and stream timeouts. I'm pulling a list of active customers with >1% error rate.

olivia (product): heads-up — two enterprise customers (AcmePlay, FinBatch) on dedicated contracts in EU are in the impacted pool. Need ETA for mitigation to craft comms.

raj (infra): checked quotas in console: project-level GPU quota for europe-west1 is zero for A100. We have capacity in europe-west4 and us-central. Autoscaler policy is region-bound; failover is disabled by default.

sara (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation options? ideas: 1) failover traffic to a different region 2) spin up CPU-only fallback nodes (lower perf) 3) reduce concurrency and route low-priority requests to cached/model-small variants 4) request urgent quota increase from GCP (slow).

maria (eng-runtime): we can flip routing policy to allow cross-region fallback to europe-west4 for affected customers. That requires a config change and deploy, but we can enable a per-tenant fallback quickly via admin API.

raj (infra): manual quota bump is fastest if we have support contact; otherwise create temporary capacity by moving some dedicated pools to other regions. But moving pools requires redeploy and model warmup.

kevin (support): AcmePlay is seeing ~40% request failures in the last 15m. FinBatch is seeing degraded throughput but not full failures yet. I'll open a private support thread and start customer outreach.

olivia (product): prioritize AcmePlay comms. We need a short message: acknowledge, say we're mitigating and offer explicit timeframe.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-14-1788888000. Priority: P1. Triage lead: sara (oncall-sre).

sara (oncall-sre): I'll take triage lead. Raj/maria — pairing on mitigation: raj please attempt to enable cross-region fallback; maria please prepare runtime configuration to route affected tenants to europe-west4 model endpoints with warm cache.

raj (infra): starting: `gcloud compute project-info describe` -> verifying quotas across regions. Also opening support case with GCP: `gcloud alpha services quota-allocations` (support ticket 123456789). ETA from GCP unknown.

maria (eng-runtime): admin API snippet to patch routing: ```POST /admin/v1/tenants/{tenant}/fallbacks {"primary_region":"europe-west1","fallback_regions":["europe-west4"]}``` I'll stage for AcmePlay first.

deploy-bot: Roll request queued: route-change for tenant AcmePlay. CI checks passed. Need explicit approval to apply to production.

raj (infra): quick check — europe-west4 has 120 A100 quota available in project. We can route some traffic there.

sara (oncall-sre): maria — go ahead with AcmePlay. raj — prepare routing and update DNS/edge rules if needed. I'll monitor queues and latency.

maria (eng-runtime): applying routing for AcmePlay now. ```PATCH /admin/v1/tenants/AcmePlay/fallbacks -> 202 Accepted```

kevin (support): AcmePlay reporting immediate drop in failures after ~90s. I'll update the customer.

olivia (product): Excellent. What's the plan for FinBatch?

raj (infra): FinBatch shares the same pool but lower traffic. We'll roll them over next; need to warm models. I'll schedule in 5m windows to avoid cache thundering.

maria (eng-runtime): rolling FinBatch now -> warm-up requests to europe-west4 to populate KV caches. Script: ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://eu4-runtime.redwood/api/v1/warm?model=gpt-small; done```

incident-bot: Note: autoscaler still failing to create new nodes in europe-west1 due to quota errors. No progress on quota increases from GCP support yet.

sara (oncall-sre): current delta: pending queue reduced from 14k to 3.1k after AcmePlay and partial FinBatch failover. 99th latency down to 2.1s for affected tenants. Good.

raj (infra): as a medium-term mitigation, we should enable region fallback in autoscaler policy and add an alert to warn if region quota is below threshold. I'll file infra ticket.

olivia (product): action items for comms: (1) notify AcmePlay & FinBatch of mitigation and follow-up (kevin) (2) public status update for EU customers if we see further impact (olivia) (3) timeline once GCP confirms quota request (sara/raj).

kevin (support): customer messages sent to AcmePlay (private), FinBatch updated. Both asked to accept cross-region routing; AcmePlay accepted, FinBatch opted for delayed failover — scheduling now.

maria (eng-runtime): FYI — fallback to europe-west4 increased cost for those tenants ~2.2x token cost due to egress and different instance pricing. We should flag billing/contract implications for finance/prod.

raj (infra): GCP support replied: case 123456789 in progress, but immediate quota increase not possible without sales support; they suggested filing a quota request which may take hours. I'll escalate through account manager.

sara (oncall-sre): handoff: my oncall window ends in 20m. I'll do a warm handoff to dan (next-sre). Dan, summary: P1 quota-exhaustion in europe-west1 caused autoscaler stall. Partial mitigation: per-tenant cross-region failover to europe-west4 applied for AcmePlay and in progress for FinBatch. Queues reduced from 14k -> 3.1k. GCP ticket open (123456789). Ongoing: monitor queue, complete FinBatch roll, and coordinate with raj on quota escalation.

sara (oncall-sre): tagging dan: @dan (oncall-sre) please acknowledge.

pagerduty-bot: Alert handoff — declaring new assignee: dan (oncall-sre).

dan (oncall-sre): acknowledged. Taking over. I'll stay on this until quotas resolved and backlog below 200.

kevin (support): customers acknowledged. AcmePlay says they're ok with cross-region but asked for a postmortem and SLA credit if prolonged. FinBatch wants confirmation when traffic moves fully.

maria (eng-runtime): long-term: propose setting autoscaler policy to allow regional fallback and add a 'soft-threshold' so we pre-warm other regions when queue > X. I'll open RFC.

raj (infra): quick follow-up actions I'm taking: 1) escalate quota with account manager 2) open infra ticket to add fallback to autoscaler 3) add monitoring for regional GPU quota percentage.

dan (oncall-sre): monitoring: dashboards pinned, alert routing adjusted to call infra on the next quota regression. I'll keep updates here.

incident-bot: Incident update logged (INC-2026-03-14-1788888000). Status: stabilizing.

olivia (product): thanks team. After this stabilizes we need a short internal postmortem and action list: autoscaler fallback, billing impact analysis, and improved customer comms playbook.

dan (oncall-sre): closing loop: pending queue now 420, 99th latency 1.2s for failover tenants. Leaving incident channel open until quota confirmed.

incident-bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" pending root-cause and quota confirmation.

sara (oncall-sre): adding notes for postmortem: root cause: region GPU quota exhausted and autoscaler lacked cross-region fallback; contributing factors: no low-priority routing, no quota pre-warn alerts, and automatic retries caused extra API calls.

raj (infra): created infra task INFRA-5372 for autoscaler-region-fallback and monitoring.

maria (eng-runtime): creating runtime follow-up: RUNTIME-2441 to add per-tenant failover toggle and warm-up orchestration.

olivia (product): I'll schedule the postmortem meeting tomorrow. Thanks all. :heart:
